# Trail Manual — trailmanual.com
> Free, community-built DIY reference for off-road vehicle owners. Flagship coverage: Jeep Cherokee XJ (330+ guides). Also: Wrangler TJ/JK/JL, Gladiator JT, Toyota 4Runner and Tacoma, Ford Bronco and F-150 Raptor, Ram Power Wagon. Answer-first guides with real torque specs, part numbers, and current prices. No sponsored content, no paid placements.

## Highest-value answer pages
- [Death Wobble: What's Actually Causing It](https://trailmanual.com/blog/xj-death-wobble-causes/): ranked culprit list — track bar first, steering stabilizer is not a fix
- [Death Wobble Survival Guide](https://trailmanual.com/db/death-wobble-guide.html): interactive diagnostic — symptom quiz, driveway inspection, fix plan
- [Jeep 4.0 Crank Position Sensor: Symptoms and the Hot-Start Test](https://trailmanual.com/blog/jeep-40-crank-position-sensor-symptoms/): heat-soak stall pattern diagnosis
- [XJ Overheating: The Diagnosis Sequence, In Order](https://trailmanual.com/blog/xj-overheating-diagnosis/): fan clutch, radiator, head gasket — in test order
- [The XJ Dana 35: When to Keep It, When to Swap It](https://trailmanual.com/blog/xj-dana-35/): C-clip failure mode, Ford 8.8 swap economics
- [XJ Lift Kit Guide](https://trailmanual.com/db/xj-lift-kit-guide.html): lift heights, driveline angles, what each stage actually requires
- [Gear Ratio Calculator](https://trailmanual.com/gear-ratio-calculator.html): tire size × axle ratio → RPM, crawl ratio, re-gear verdict
- [V8 Swap Parts Checklist](https://trailmanual.com/v8-swap-parts-checklist.html): complete XJ/TJ V8 swap parts list with prices
- [Parts Compatibility Tool](https://trailmanual.com/db/parts-compatibility-tool.html): cross-vehicle junkyard interchange
- [DIY Database](https://trailmanual.com/db/): 850+ guides across 10 platforms, filterable by category
- [The Workshop](https://trailmanual.com/workshop/): vehicle-agnostic tools, safety, and technique fundamentals
